A third-party page describes Seeds of Awareness as a Bay Area nonprofit with operations in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda location
Search results (not independently fetched) tie Seeds of Awareness to work with students at Oakland International High School, which appears in the OUSD contract titles
research.notes: Organization appears defunct (ceased operations June 30, 2022; IRS exempt status revoked per GuideStar). Its own website could not be fetched (certificate errors), so contact details were omitted. Public sources give conflicting addresses (Berkeley PO Box, Petaluma, Oakland). Link to Oakland Unified is inferred from name, service type and a search snippet, not from a fetched page.

profile.summary: A Bay Area nonprofit that provided counseling and mentorship in schools, taught social-emotional learning in classrooms, and ran mindfulness-based counseling and nature-based social skills groups. The organization has reported that it ceased operations as of June 30, 2022.
